notice: Every repository, file, line, excerpt, and finding below is invented fixture data.

findings.title: Untrusted search text reaches a shell command
findings.description: Request-controlled text is interpolated into a shell command. A safer argument-vector call removes shell parsing and constrains the operation to the intended search executable.
findings.recommendation: Replace the shell string with a fixed executable and validated argument list; keep the allowed search scope explicit.

findings.title: Object storage allows public reads
findings.description: The synthetic infrastructure fixture enables anonymous reads. Confirm intended access patterns, then require an explicit authenticated principal.
findings.recommendation: Disable public access at the bucket and account levels; add a regression assertion for the intended principal boundary.

findings.title: SQL query is assembled with string concatenation
findings.description: The fixture query inserts a value into SQL source text. Parameterized queries keep user input in the data channel rather than executable syntax.
findings.recommendation: Use a parameterized query and add a regression case containing SQL punctuation as ordinary input.

evidence.excerpt: cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" + name + "'")

findings.title: Build action is referenced by a mutable tag
findings.description: The workflow fixture references an action tag that may change. Pinning a verified commit makes the dependency input stable and reviewable.
findings.recommendation: Pin the action to a reviewed full commit digest and document the version beside the reference.
